description: This file contains server-side logic for the StartExam.aspx page in an online examination system. It manages user session validation, dynamically loads course options based on user semester, handles exam selection, initiates exam sessions, and verifies if a student has already taken a specific exam. It also includes navigation controls to other pages.
external_methods: select count(*) from theoryQS where course
select count(*) from mcqQS where course

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam.aspx page, handling user session, course loading, exam selection, and navigation within the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load; checks session validity, dynamically loads course list based on user semester.

methods.description: Currently empty; placeholder for select button click event.

methods.description: Starts the selected exam based on exam type (Theory or MCQ), checks if questions exist, and sets session variables accordingly.

methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.
